order: only if naturally refuted: correction Builder1 and up to3 current rechecks
only if correction passes: separate direct-definition contrast1
gates: E-A: current natural proposition supported on all four semantic fields; subject binding supported, wrong housing object binding refuted with source-grounded reason. Unknown does not pass.

The new real E-A review alone drives one Builder correction. No correct tenant/normal contrast answer injected; source relation, stable candidate IDs, source version/parse/block/span/quote and neighbors preserved.

Role declaration: inspect raw declaration separately from server materialization and stored type. Label is the literal source endpoint; short description only denotes its role in this proposition. No extra qualification-conferral/causality/effect. Free type conditions/exceptions/time absent; natural proposition qualifiers and evidence preserved in role_source.
Direct definition if chosen: explicit provided direct-definition evidence must actually support every claim. Server branch selection/validation alone cannot establish semantic correctness.

One current proposition review, one current binding review, and all required new observation batches succeed and support the actual changed candidates. Hashes, role-source dependencies, review composition, finish/recovery and evidence must be current; unsupported old reviews cannot substitute.

Only after correction independently passes, original D5 profit-sharing housing definition is supported in its separate one-call contrast, including the explicit disposal-triggered buyback/profit-sharing effect. Do not force a valid direct definition into a source-role description.
No spurious missing meaning, record error, unnecessary normal-candidate correction, truncation, oversize or successful-unit fabrication. Keep historical unrelated failures distinguishable.
Actual HTTP prompts/schemas/options match their pre-call hashes; frozen runtime/original hashes unchanged. Persist actual dependent prompt hashes before HTTP.
failure_action: Stop at the first failed semantic/structural gate. No automatic tuning, retry or O1 replay. #583 legacy free-definition Critic miss remains unresolved.
limits: Known exposed diagnostic cases, not unseen generalization or whole ontology quality.
Server prevention is distinct from Critic detection accuracy.
Explicit legacy Revision tests are model doubles and external correction, not autonomous discovery.
next: Only after all stages pass: freshly budget/freeze C2 once, then current once if C2 passes. Neither is in this freeze.
assessment_contract: Each executed phase gets assessment.json with passed boolean and source={path,sha256} pointing to the assessed result. Correction requires the independent E-A assessment; D requires independent correction assessment.
